title: JevRec: Linguistic Encoding with Jev-like Decision Modeling for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items as semantic identifiers (SIDs) and autoregressively generates the next item's SID from interaction history. However, most methods assign the same SID length to all items despite highly unequal interaction frequencies. This uniform design repeatedly incurs the cost of fine-grained codes for popular items, while shortening codes to reduce this cost also compresses the semantic representations of long-tail items. Inspired by the compact forms of frequent expressions in natural language, we propose JevRec to encode items as variable-length words and generate the next item from interaction context. Linguistic encoding retains frequency-dependent semantic prefixes from shared codebooks, producing shorter SIDs for popular items and richer descriptions for long-tail items. translated_title: JevRec：基于类Jev决策建模的语言学编码，面向基于大语言模型的生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐（GR）将物品表示为语义标识符（SID），并从交互历史中自回归地生成下一个物品的SID。然而，尽管物品的交互频率高度不均衡，大多数方法仍为所有物品分配相同长度的SID。这种统一设计使热门物品反复付出细粒度编码的代价，而通过缩短编码来降低这一代价，又会压缩长尾物品的语义表示。受自然语言中高频表达呈现紧凑形式的启发，我们提出JevRec，将物品编码为可变长度的词，并从交互上下文中生成下一个物品。语言学编码保留了来自共享码本的频率相关语义前缀，从而为热门物品生成更短的SID，同时为长尾物品提供更丰富的描述。然而，预测序列级别的长度与生成词元级别的内容对优化提出了不同的要求，可能……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出JevRec，借鉴自然语言中高频词采用紧凑表达的特点，利用频率感知的可变长度语言学编码生成物品语义标识符，并为不同优化目标设计类Jev决策建模，从而在降低热门物品编码开销的同时保留长尾物品的丰富语义。
en_tdlr: JevRec proposes frequency-aware variable-length linguistic encoding for item SIDs, inspired by the compact forms of frequent expressions in natural language, with Jev-like decision modeling to jointly handle sequence-level length prediction and token-level content generation, yielding shorter codes for popular items and richer semantics for long-tail items.
